Sliding window: window_size - max_freq <= k. O(n).

For repeating char replacement basic I will expand the window and shrink when it exceeds k.

```python
def character_replacement(s, k):
    from collections import Counter
    counts = Counter()
    lo = 0; max_freq = 0; out = 0
    for hi, c in enumerate(s):
        counts[c] += 1
        max_freq = max(max_freq, counts[c])
        if hi - lo + 1 - max_freq > k:
            counts[s[lo]] -= 1; lo += 1
        out = max(out, hi - lo + 1)
    return out
```
